title: MS60012: Semiconductor Technology
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: None
Introduction to polymer reaction engineering; types of polymerization; basic
polymerization kinetics, control and analysis of polymerization reaction,
molecular weight. MWD, chain branching, cross linking/gelation. Polymerization
reactors, types and mode of operation. Polymerization reactor design, control
of polymerization. Storage and handling of raw materials; considerations for
design, safety and installation of storage facility for monomers, solvents and
catalysts, transport systems. Post polymerization unit operations and unit
processes : Cleaning and maintenance of polymerization reactors and pipe lines.
